slug: 2020-01-24 Namibia Case Study Highlights Importance of Data Policy Alignment for SDG 16.9

facts.fact: The IISD report on a Global Partnership for Sustainable Development Data compendium says the e-birth and e-death notification platforms are linked to the National Population Registration System through the National Data Exchange Service Bus interoperability layer, which also lets the register link to other government and private-sector registers; no date for the link is given and the count of connected systems is not stated.

NAM.note: as_of is the published date, the document giving no event date.

The document says the population register links to functional registers of government and the private sector and that birth and death registration is a prerequisite for social grants; it states no system checking people against the national ID.
